properties.name: Donner Memorial State Park
properties.note: Six-foot leash; dogs allowed on the Lakeside Interpretive Trail, Zig Zag Trail, fire roads, and the Donner Lake shore except China Cove Beach. No dogs in the visitor center, on the Nature Trail, or on designated ski trails when snow is present.

properties.name: West End Beach
properties.note: The district's main Donner Lake swim beach — no dogs (posted with the no-glass and no-smoking rules).

properties.name: Truckee River Regional Park
